observation.defect: The MLB fields query does not guarantee an exact minimal nested player surface. Treating the transport body as opportunity-only raw evidence was false.

repair.method: The transport adapter now validates required identities and produces a canonical positive projection containing only game/date/final status, team IDs, player IDs, batting order, and plate appearances.

offline_fixture.purpose: Replay the approved positive projection and both-team parsing without retaining unrelated transport fields.

limitations: The original transport body is deliberately not retained by this candidate; the offline fixture replays the canonical projection while its recorded transport hash cannot independently reconstruct the discarded transport.
The transport hash is computed at collection time and requires trusted collector-code and runtime identity.
This source audit does not create prospective evidence and cannot satisfy any model, holdout, promotion, market, ROI, or betting gate.
A future live non-May collection under an immutable pregame plan remains required.
